# Doing less cleaning here and saving it for the recipe 
mhData <- mhData %>% 
  # Not interested in obs we dont have the price/response
  filter(!is.na(Price)) %>% 
  # Unique var, date, and seller (not interested)
  select(-c(Address, SellerG)) %>%
  # Making some cols factors
  mutate(across(c(Type, Method, Regionname, Suburb, CouncilArea), as.factor)) %>%
  # high outliers
  mutate(Price = log(Price)) %>%
  mutate(Date = dmy(Date))

title: St558 Project 3
text:
Splitting data and doing 5 fold

set.seed(711)
mhData_split <- rsample::initial_split(mhData, prop = 0.7)
mhData_train <- training(mhData_split)
mhData_test <- testing(mhData_split)

mhData_5_fold <- vfold_cv(mhData_train, 5)

title: St558 Project 3
section: Recipe for the trees, impute here
text:
Recipe for the trees, impute here

mh_rec <- recipe(Price ~ ., data = mhData_train) %>%
  step_impute_median(Bedroom2, Bathroom, Car, Landsize, BuildingArea, YearBuilt, Lattitude, Longtitude) %>% 
  step_date(Date, features = c("month", "dow", "year"), keep_original_cols = FALSE) %>%
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors())

title: St558 Project 3
section: Models for Regression and Random Forest model
text:
Models for Regression and Random Forest model
I use the RMSE and MAD as the metric as RMSE penalizes the errors and MAD helps look at the outliers (although that might be covered by the earlier log operation on price). The RMSE will the one I use the most.

title: St558 Project 3
section: Fitting the model to get the best of each type
text:
Fitting the model to get the best of each type

Reg tree
Workflow for tree

tree_mod <- decision_tree(tree_depth = tune(),
                          min_n = 20,
                          cost_complexity = tune()) %>%
  set_engine("rpart") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

tree_wkf <- workflow() %>% add_recipe(mh_rec) %>%
  add_model(tree_mod)

Fit workflow on folds

tree_grid <- grid_regular(cost_complexity(),
                          tree_depth(),
                          levels = c(10, 5))
tree_fits <- tree_wkf %>% 
  tune_grid(resamples = mhData_5_fold,
            grid = tree_grid,
            metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

tree_best_params <- select_best(tree_fits, metric = "rmse")

tree_final_wkf <- tree_wkf %>% finalize_workflow(tree_best_params)

tree_final_fit <- tree_final_wkf %>% last_fit(mhData_split, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))



Random Forest
Workflow for random forest

rf_spec <- rand_forest(mtry = tune(),
                       min_n = tune()) %>% 
  set_engine("ranger") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

rf_wkf <- workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(mh_rec) %>%
  add_model(rf_spec)

Fit workflow on folds

rf_fit <- rf_wkf %>% tune_grid(resamples = mhData_5_fold, 
                                 grid = 10, 
                               metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))

rf_best_params <- select_best(rf_fit, metric = "rmse")

rf_final_wkf <- rf_wkf %>% finalize_workflow(rf_best_params)
rf_final_fit <- rf_final_wkf %>% last_fit(mhData_split, metrics = metric_set(rmse, mae))



Finding best model in each of the models

rbind(
  tree_final_fit %>%
    collect_metrics() %>% 
    mutate(Model = "TREE", .before = ".metric"),
  rf_final_fit %>%
    collect_metrics() %>% 
    mutate(Model = "RF", .before = ".metric")  
)

section: Best model gets fitted to the entire data, saved with bundle
text:
Best model gets fitted to the entire data, saved with bundle

rf_final_model_full <- rf_final_wkf %>%
  fit(data = mhData)

rf_model_full <- extract_fit_engine(rf_final_model_full)


rf_bundle <- bundle(rf_final_model_full)
saveRDS(rf_bundle, "rf_bundle.rds")
